# Mock CK3 base game

A stand-in for the CK3 `game` directory (the folder holding `common/`), for the graphics-file
check (GFX001) tests: `gfx/interface/icons/mock_base_icon.dds` is a base-game file and
`dlc/dlc001_mock/gfx/interface/icons/mock_dlc_icon.dds` a DLC file. The `.dds` files are
placeholders; only their existence matters. `common/` holds no script, so the base game
defines nothing.
